input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no ownership or licence provision at all for the Site, code, look-and-feel or other work product HDI designs and develops for us, and none for our Content, user information and customer/order data (referenced only as Confidential Information in Section 8.1). Section 5.2 gives us artistic and editorial control and Section 1.4 gives access to HDI's tools, but neither confers any IP rights or licence in the deliverables, and nothing limits HDI's use of our data. Because HDI bears all development cost under Sections 1.2 and 1.6, we target the fallback rather than a full assignment: HDI retains its generic tools and know-how while we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business, and any HDI licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 5.5 granting the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables, with HDI retaining its generic tools and know-how and any HDI licence in Company data limited to providing the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership and licensing of the Site and other work product HDI develops for us, and on HDI's rights in our Content and customer/order data. We have added our fallback position: HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business, and any HDI licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership; License. HDI shall retain ownership of its generic tools and know-how. HDI hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Site and any other deliverables and work product developed for the Company under this Agreement for its business. Any license or right of HDI in Content, user information, data or other materials belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company is limited to processing the same solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
